```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

## PATCH 1: Patch in correct Major_Functional_Group for small pelagic genera.
NOTE TO SELF: This patch may not be necessary if / when I can correct it in the raw fisheries data. - EMF, Oct 19 2026

```{r Prep StockStatus_Scores}
colnames(StockStatus_Scores0)

StockStatus_Scores <- StockStatus_Scores0 %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id = clean_names_lowercase(OHI_region_est),
    estimated_genus_name = clean_names_lowercase(estimated_genus_name)
  ) %>%
  select(-OHI_region_est)
# 4130 obs., 18 vars.

# PATCH:

StockStatus_Scores<- StockStatus_Scores %>%
  select(-c(Major_Functional_Group)) %>%
  left_join(
    GenusGroup_lookup, 
    by= c("estimated_genus_name")
  )
# 4130 obs., 18 vars. Good.
# The patch worked. FOFM is fixed now.

```


## Take Stock_Status of FOFM taxa (reference point):
Reference point: the stock status (B/Bmsy) of taxa used for fish oil and fish meal (i.e., small pelagics) is close to 1 across regions x year
Reference period: 2018-2024

Model: Calculate the average stock_status of small pelagics (region x year), weight geometrically by total catch per stock (region x year).


```{r Create FOFM_StockStatus list}
unique(StockStatus_Scores$Major_Functional_Group)

FOFM_Taxa<- c("anchovy & sardine (small pelagics)")

colnames(StockStatus_Scores)

FOFM_StockStatus<- StockStatus_Scores %>%
  filter(Major_Functional_Group %in% FOFM_Taxa) %>%
    select(year, Major_Functional_Group,
           estimated_genus_name, estimated_family_name,
           rgn_id,
           total_weight_mt,
           StockStatus_final,
           StockStatus_source
         )

# 80 obs., 8 vars.

unique(FOFM_StockStatus$estimated_genus_name)
# 7 unique genera of small pelagic fish.
```

```{r Apply FOFM correction factor: 70% of all catch goes to Fish Oil Fish Meal}
FOFM_PROPORTION<- 0.70

FOFM_StockStatus<- FOFM_StockStatus %>%
  mutate(
    FOFM_weight_mt= total_weight_mt * FOFM_PROPORTION
  )
# 80 obs., 9 vars.
```


## Calculate FOFM_SubScores as the geometric mean of Stock_Status * FOFM_weight_mt:

# DECISION POINT: Select FOFM_START and FOFM_END:
```{r Select FOFM_START and FOFM_END}
FOFM_START= 2018
FOFM_END= 2024
```

```{r Weights and geometric mean}
# Calculate the GEOMETRIC proportion of catch each "Stock" (i.e. genus) contributed to its regional total during the study period:
colnames(FOFM_StockStatus)

FOFM_weights <- FOFM_StockStatus %>%
  filter(year >= FOFM_START & year <= FOFM_END) %>%
  group_by(estimated_genus_name, rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(FOFM_stock_catch_mt = sum(FOFM_weight_mt)) %>% # total tonnes across all years for each stock and region during the study period
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(total_FOFM_catch_mt = sum(FOFM_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% # total tonnes catch across all years and stocks for each region
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(wprop_2018.24 = FOFM_stock_catch_mt / total_FOFM_catch_mt) %>% # proportion of catch each stock contributed to the total catch
  distinct(estimated_genus_name, rgn_id, wprop_2018.24)


# SANITY CHECK: Do the weights add up to 1?
TEST<- FOFM_weights %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarize(sum_w = sum(wprop_2018.24, na.rm= TRUE))
# 9 obs., vars.; all = 1. Yup, looks good!
```

```{r Add weights data to Stock Status df:}
colnames(FOFM_weights)

FOFM_SubScores0 <- FOFM_StockStatus %>%
  left_join(FOFM_weights,
            by = c("rgn_id", "estimated_genus_name"))


colnames(FOFM_SubScores0)

# This is the geometric mean part:
FOFM_SubScores0 <- FOFM_SubScores0 %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>%
  summarize(
    FOFM_landings_mt = sum(FOFM_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    FOFM_StockStatus_geo.mean = prod(StockStatus_final ^ wprop_2018.24, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(FOFM_score= FOFM_StockStatus_geo.mean * 100,
         FOFM_score= round(FOFM_score, 2)
         )

# 31 obs., 5 vars.
```

```{r Complete the FOFM_SubScores grid}
FOFM_SubScores <- FOFM_SubScores0 %>%
  complete(
    rgn_id = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      FOFM_StockStatus_geo.mean = NA_real_,
      FOFM_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

# 64 obs., 5 vars.
```

```{r Join rgn_name to scores and complete final df}
colnames(Region_Key)
colnames(FOFM_SubScores)

FOFM_SubScores <- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  mutate(rgn_id = stringr::str_to_title(rgn_id))

FOFM_SubScores <- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  left_join(
    Region_Key,
    by = c("rgn_id")
  )
```


# FORM EXCLUSION CRITERIA: regional mean production (2018-2024) relative to median production across all regions (2018-2024).

```{r Add EXCLUSION CRITERIA for FOFM? Might not use.}
summary(FOFM_SubScores$FOFM_landings_mt) # median = 295.8, mean = 88314.0

# Take the median production (in mt) across all regions, all years.
exclusion_threshold <- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_id)) %>%
  pull(FOFM_landings_mt) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

FOFM_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

FOFM_SubScores <- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_rgn_landings_mt = mean(FOFM_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(mean_rgn_landings_mt) ~ "exclude",
      mean_rgn_landings_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      mean_rgn_landings_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 64 obs., 8 vars.

# Re-order:
colnames(FOFM_SubScores)

FOFM_SubScores<- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, 
         FOFM_landings_mt, mean_rgn_landings_mt, FOFM_StockStatus_geo.mean, FOFM_score, 
         region_exclude_include)

```

```{r Sanity check final FOFM_SubScores}

summary(FOFM_SubScores$FOFM_score)

  #  Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.    NA's 
  # 24.13   55.86   85.73   74.42  100.00  100.00      33 

# Year 2024 mean for FOFM_SubScores:
mean(FOFM_SubScores$FOFM_score[FOFM_SubScores$year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE)
# 75.5
```

```{r Plot FOFM_SubScores over time}
Region_colors<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

colnames(FOFM_SubScores)

FOFM_SubScores_plot<- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_name)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = FOFM_score,
    color = rgn_name
    )) +
  
  # Excluded regions in grey
  geom_line(
    data = ~ filter(.x, region_exclude_include == "exclude"),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ filter(.x, region_exclude_include == "exclude"),
    color = "grey75",
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Included regions in their original colors
  geom_line(
    data = ~ filter(.x, region_exclude_include == "include"),
    aes(color = rgn_name),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ filter(.x, region_exclude_include == "include"),
    aes(color = rgn_name),
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ rgn_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "NP: FOFM Scores by Region",
    subtitle= "summed FOFM genera", 
    caption = "updated: Oct 19 2026",
    y = "FOFM Current Status (0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = Region_colors) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

FOFM_SubScores_plot
```

# Should there be more landings from ANCHOVETA and SARDINA in other regions? Double check: seems like no.

```{r Evaluate small pelagics from GOC_MarineLandings0 directly}
GOC_MarineLandings0<- readRDS(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/fp/cleaned_CONAPESCA/GOC_Marine.Landings_Sector.Sorted.Georef_PATCHED_Jun032026.rds"))
# 3246583 obs., 58 var.

colnames(GOC_MarineLandings0)
unique(GOC_MarineLandings0$recorded_taxa_group)

GOC_FOFM_Landings<- GOC_MarineLandings0 %>%
  filter(recorded_taxa_group %in% c("ANCHOVETA", "SARDINA")) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2024) %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, weight_kg_corrected) %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarize(
    total_landings_mt = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm= TRUE) / 1000,
    FOFM_landings_mt = total_landings_mt * 0.70
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id= clean_names_lowercase(OHI_region_est)
  ) %>%
  select(-OHI_region_est)
# 43 obs., 4 vars.

# NOTE TO SELF: Based on this summary table, it does not seem like we are missing huge sums of FOFM in other regions. Seems like most small pelagic production does actually originate from regions 7 and 8.
# We are missing some FOFM production (minimal), however, this is production that cannot be assigned to a specific genus. Therefore, we cannot evaluate it's stock status.
# The FOFM score (and associated production) reflects FOFM production that can be identified to at least the genus level.
```

# >> FLAG likely natural products based on record details:

```{r Remove entries where no weight whatsoever is logged: NP_Landings}
colnames(GOC_MarineFisheryLandings)

NP_Landings00 <- GOC_MarineFisheryLandings %>%
  filter(!(is.na(weight_kg_corrected) | weight_kg_corrected == 0)) %>%
  select(-recorded_taxa_name, -recorded_taxa_name_clean,
         -live_weight, -landed_weight, 
         -keywords_1, -keywords_2, -keywords_3, -keywords_4, 
         everything(),
         recorded_taxa_name, recorded_taxa_name_clean,
         keywords_1, keywords_2, keywords_3, keywords_4,
         live_weight, landed_weight) %>%
  select(-c(weight_kg_corrected))
```

```{r First check if there is a discrepancy between wet weight and landed weight}

NP_Landings0 <- NP_Landings00 %>%

    !is.na(live_weight) &
    !is.na(landed_weight) &

      "live weight is greater than landed weight",

    !is.na(live_weight) &
    !is.na(landed_weight) &
    live_weight < landed_weight ~
      "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?",

    !is.na(live_weight) &
    !is.na(landed_weight) &
    live_weight == landed_weight ~
      "live weight equals landed weight",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
```

# Estimate the weight of animal versus fillet versus residues:
If SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" & live.landed_discrepancy== "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = landed_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = live_weight
If SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight equals landed weight" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = live_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = NA
If SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight is greater than landed weight; suggests catch prepared before sold" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = live_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = landed_weight

If (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES")  & live.landed_discrepancy== "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = landed_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = live_weight
If (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight equals landed weight" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = NA & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = landed_weight
If (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight is greater than landed weight; suggests catch prepared before sold" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = live_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = landed_weight

```{r Make a recorded_weightOFanimal_kg and recorded_weightOFfillet_kg columns}

NP_Landings0 <- NP_Landings0 %>%
  mutate(
    recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = case_when(
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & (live_weight == 0) ~ NA_real_,
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ landed_weight,
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ live_weight,
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ live_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ NA_real_,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ live_weight,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = case_when(
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      Residue_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ live_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    recorded_weightOFresidue_kg = case_when(
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      Fillet_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & (live_weight == 0) ~ landed_weight,
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & (landed_weight == 0) ~ live_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ live_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        is.na(live.landed_discrepancy) ~ landed_weight,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r FLAG likely NPs based on keywords in the record's preparation landing site and common name}
TaxaName_strong.clues<- c("PECES ORNATO", "ABANDERADO", "ALA ANGEL", "PAYASO",
                          "CABALLITO MAR", "PEZ PIPA",
                          "TOTOABA",
                          "ESTRELLA MAR", "ESTRELLA LIMPIADORA", "GALLETA MAR",
                          "CARACOL", "HACHA", "CALLO", "CALLO HACHA", "CALLO MEDIA LUNA",
                          "MADRE PERLA",

                        "MURENA", "MORENA",
                        "SOLDADITO",
                        "MEDUSA BOLA CAÑÓN")


# Build regex patterns dynamically:

Keyword_strong.pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(NP_strong.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
Keyword_weak.pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(NP_weak.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
Keyword_opposite.pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(NP_opposite.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

LandingSite_pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(LandingSite_clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

TaxaGroup_pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(TaxaGroup_strong.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
TaxaName_strong.pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(TaxaName_strong.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
TaxaName_weak.pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(TaxaName_weak.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

# Implement regex key:
NP_Landings <- NP_Landings0 %>%
  
  mutate(
    NP.Keyword_FLAG = case_when(
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4, ~ str_detect(.x, regex(Keyword_strong.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) ~ "YES",
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4, ~ str_detect(.x, regex(Keyword_weak.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) ~ "MAYBE",
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4, ~ str_detect(.x, regex(Keyword_opposite.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) ~ "NO",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    ),
    
    NP.Site_FLAG = case_when(
      str_detect(landing_site_clean, regex(LandingSite_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "YES",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    ),
    
    NP.Group_FLAG = case_when(
      str_detect(recorded_taxa_group, regex(TaxaGroup_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "YES",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    ),
    
    NP.TaxaName_FLAG = case_when(
      str_detect(recorded_taxa_name_clean, regex(TaxaName_strong.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "YES",
      str_detect(recorded_taxa_name_clean, regex(TaxaName_weak.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "MAYBE",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    )
  )
```

## Calculate ORNA reference points:
Reference point: "Production stays steady." I have interpreted this as: production of aquarium trade taxa should be stable, at or near, the 2018-2022 mean production (in kg). With no penalty for under harvest (added September 5 2026).
Reference period: 2018-2022

# DECISION POINT: Select ORNA_REF_START and ORNA_REF_END:
```{r Select ORNA_REF_START and ORNA_REF_END}
ORNA_REF_START= 2018
ORNA_REF_END= 2022
```

```{r Calculate ORNA reference point}
colnames(ORNA_Landings_summary)

# Sum this year (by region) and compare to the mean annual regional volume over 2018–2022:
ORNA_ref_points <- ORNA_Landings_summary %>%
  filter(year >= ORNA_REF_START & year <= ORNA_REF_END) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_prod_2018.22 = mean(tot_annual_prod_kg, na.rm = TRUE))
# 10 obs., 2 vars.

```

## Calculate ORNA_SubScores:
```{r Calculate ORNA_SubScores}

# Prep ORNA_SubScores0:
ORNA_SubScores0<- ORNA_Landings_summary %>%
  left_join(ORNA_ref_points,
    by= c("rgn_id")
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018 & year <= 2024)
# 65 obs., 7 vars.

colnames(ORNA_SubScores0)

# Score = 1 when annual_prod_kg is within ±10% of mean_prod_2018.22
# If annual production is within ±10% of the 2018–2022 average (90%–110% of the average), the subscore is 1.
# If annual production exceeds 110% of the 2018–2022 average, the subscore is 1 - ratio, with a minimum of 0.
# If annual production is less than 90% of the 2018–2022 average, the subscore equals the production ratio.
# For example, if production is 80% of the average (ratio = 0.8), the subscore is 0.8.
# If production is 50% of the average (ratio = 0.5), the subscore is 0.5.

ORNA_SubScores <- ORNA_SubScores0 %>%
  filter(year >= 2018 & year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio = tot_annual_prod_kg / mean_prod_2018.22,

    ORNA_score_prop = case_when(
      ratio < 0.9 ~ ratio,
      ratio >= 0.9 & ratio <= 1.1 ~ 1,
      ratio > 1.1  ~ pmax(0, 1 - abs(1-ratio))
    ),
    
    ORNA_score= ORNA_score_prop * 100
  )
# 65 obs., 10 vars.

```

```{r Complete the ORNA_SubScore grid}
colnames(ORNA_SubScores0)

ORNA_SubScores <- ORNA_SubScores %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    rgn_id = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      ORNA_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

# 66 obs., 10 vars.
```

# ORNA EXCLUSION CRITERIA? regional mean production (2018-2024) relative to median production across all regions (2018-2024).

```{r Add EXCLUSION CRITERIA for ORNA? Might not use.}
ORNA_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_rgn_production_kg = mean(tot_annual_prod_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(mean_rgn_production_kg) ~ "exclude",
      mean_rgn_production_kg <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      mean_rgn_production_kg > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 66 obs., 12 vars.
```

## Calculate RESD reference points: different reference points for shrimp vs. demersal fish
Reference point: "Full utilization of harvest amount." Different reference points for shrimp vs. demersal fish listed below. These can be changed.
Reference period: 2018-2024

Sources: https://www.fao.org/4/t0219e/t0219e00.htm
https://www.fao.org/flw-in-fish-value-chains/resources/articles/detail/fish-by-products-utilization--getting-more-benefits-from-fish-processing/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com

```{r RESD reference points for shrimp and fish}
shrimp.RESD_PROP_TOTAL_MASS = 0.30
shrimp.FILLET_PROP_TOTAL_MASS = 0.57
shrimp.RESD_REF_COEFF = shrimp.RESD_PROP_TOTAL_MASS / shrimp.FILLET_PROP_TOTAL_MASS
# FAO citation for Penaeus shrimp: edible meat (57%)

fish.FILLET_PROP_TOTAL_MASS = 0.30
fish.RESD_PROP_TOTAL_MASS = 0.30
fish.RESD_REF_COEFF = fish.FILLET_PROP_TOTAL_MASS / fish.RESD_PROP_TOTAL_MASS
# FAO citation for Whiting: skinless fillets (32%)
```

```{r Summarize}
colnames(RESD_Production_summary0)
unique(RESD_Production_summary0$Major_Functional_Group)

RESD_Production_summary <- RESD_Production_summary0 %>%
  group_by(year, rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  mutate(
    fillet_mt = first(
      total_weight_mt[record_type == "fillet"],
      default = NA_real_
    ),
    ref_coeff = case_when(
      Major_Functional_Group == "shrimps, prawns" ~ shrimp.RESD_REF_COEFF,
      Major_Functional_Group == "demersal marine fishes"   ~ fish.RESD_REF_COEFF,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    ref_point_mt = if_else(
      record_type == "other residue",
      fillet_mt * ref_coeff,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

RESD_Production_summary_wide <- RESD_Production_summary %>%
  select(
    year, rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group,
    record_type, total_weight_mt
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = record_type,
    values_from = total_weight_mt
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sold_whole_mt = `sold whole`,
    fillet_mt = fillet,
    residue_mt = `other residue`,
    preparation_unknown_mt = `preparation unknown`
  )

# Calculate taxon-specific RESD reference points
RESD_Production_summary_wide <- RESD_Production_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(
    ref_coeff = case_when(
      Major_Functional_Group == "shrimps, prawns" ~ shrimp.RESD_REF_COEFF,
      Major_Functional_Group == "demersal marine fishes"   ~ fish.RESD_REF_COEFF,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    ref_point_mt = fillet_mt * ref_coeff
  ) %>%
  select(
    year, rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group,
    sold_whole_mt, fillet_mt, ref_point_mt,
    residue_mt, preparation_unknown_mt
  )

colnames(RESD_Production_summary_wide)
# 252 obs., 7 vars.
```

## Calculate RESD_SubScores:

```{r Calculate RESD_SubScores}
RESD_SubScores0 <- RESD_Production_summary_wide %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    RESD_score_prop = case_when(
      # if residues production is lower than reference point, that's not great, score < 100
      residue_mt <= ref_point_mt ~ (residue_mt/ref_point_mt),

      # if residues production is higher than reference point then score = 100?
      residue_mt > ref_point_mt ~ 1,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    RESD_score = pmin(RESD_score_prop * 100, 100)
  )
# 137 obs., 10 vars.
```

```{r Plot RESD_SubScores}
  ) +
  geom_point(

    aes(color = rgn_name),

  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ rgn_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "NP: RESD Scores by Region",

    caption = "updated: Oct 19 2026",

  ) +
  
  ylim(c(0, 101)) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = Region_colors) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
```

## Calculate MINE reference point:
Salt reference point: "Salt production from all mines roughly equals production from Hermosillio, a great example of a good, sustainable mine."
Salt reference period: 2018-2022

```{r Calculate salt and gypsum reference points}
table(Anuario_data_municipality$municipality)
colnames(Anuario_data_rgn)

MINE_REF_START = 2018
MINE_REF_END = 2022

# Salt reference point: mean production in Hermosillo, 2018–2022
SAL_ref_points <- Anuario_data_municipality %>%
  filter(
    mineral_type == "Sal",
    municipality == "Hermosillo",
    year >= MINE_REF_START,
    year <= MINE_REF_END
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Sal_ref_point_mt = mean(production_tonnes, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# Sal
# 24850.4 mt

# Gypsum reference point: mine-specific mean production, 2018–2022
YESO_ref_points <- Anuario_data_rgn %>%
  filter(
    mineral_type == "Yeso",
    year >= MINE_REF_START,
    year <= MINE_REF_END
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    Yeso_ref_point_mt = mean(mean_prod_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

YESO_ref_points

# Region_6
# 94557.6500
# 
# Region_7
# 147525.0000
# 
# Region_8
# 320.1633

```


## Calculate MINE_SubScores: different calculation for Sal versus Yeso

```{r Calculate SubScores for Salt}
# Calculate the scores PER MINE MINE relative to the reference point:
# NOTE: Salt production is widely considered sustainable and renewable while Gypsum is not. Therefore, these scores do not penalize salt production over the reference point but they do penalize gypsum over the reference point. Penality is linear on both sides of 100 with a 10% buffer.

# Combine reference points with the production data
SAL_data_municipality <- Anuario_data_municipality %>%
  filter(mineral_type == "Sal") %>%
  mutate(
    Sal_ref_point_mt = SAL_ref_points$Sal_ref_point_mt
  )
# 59 obs., 8 vars.


REF_POINT_BUFFER = 0.1 # 10% buffer

colnames(SAL_data_municipality)

SALT_Scores_per_mine <- SAL_data_municipality %>%
  mutate(
    
    ratio = production_tonnes / Sal_ref_point_mt,

    SALT_score_per.mine = case_when(
      mineral_type == "Sal" ~ pmin(ratio * 100, 100),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    SALT_score_per.mine = round(SALT_score_per.mine, 2)
  )
# 59 obs., 10 vars.

```

```{r # Compress scores by region (weight the contribution of each mine by total production)}
# Next take mean across all mines in that region (weight the contribution of each mine by total production):
colnames(SALT_Scores_per_mine)

SALT_SubScores0 <- SALT_Scores_per_mine %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>%
  summarise(
    median_prod_mt_per.mine = median(production_tonnes, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_mines_per_region = n_distinct(municipality),
    mines_per_region = paste(
      sort(unique(municipality)), collapse = ", "),
    mean_regional_ref.point_mt = mean(Sal_ref_point_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    SALT_score = weighted.mean(
      SALT_score_per.mine,
      w = production_tonnes,
      na.rm = FALSE
    ),
    
    SALT_score= round(SALT_score, 2),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Be sure to account for regional zeros:
  mutate(
    SALT_score = if_else(
      !is.na(median_prod_mt_per.mine) & is.na(SALT_score),
      0,
      SALT_score
    )
  )
# 27 obs., 7 vars.

```

```{r Calculate SubScores for Gypsum}
# Calculate the scores PER MINE MINE relative to the reference point:
# NOTE: Salt production is widely considered sustainable and renewable while Gypsum is not. Therefore, these scores do not penalize salt production over the reference point but they do penalize gypsum over the reference point. Penality is linear on both sides of 100 with a 10% buffer.

# Combine reference points with the production data
YESO_data_rgn <- Anuario_data_rgn %>%
  filter(mineral_type == "Yeso") %>%
  left_join(YESO_ref_points,
            by= c("rgn_id")
  ) %>%
  rename(production_tonnes = mean_prod_mt)
  
# 20 obs., 5 vars.


REF_POINT_BUFFER = 0.1 # 10% buffer

colnames(YESO_data_rgn)

YESO_SubScores0 <- YESO_data_rgn %>%
  mutate(
    ratio = production_tonnes / Yeso_ref_point_mt,

    YESO_score = case_when(
      is.na(ratio) ~ NA_real_,
      abs(ratio - 1) <= REF_POINT_BUFFER ~ 100,
      TRUE ~ pmax(
        0,
        100 * (1 - abs(ratio - 1))
      )
    ),
    YESO_score= round(YESO_score, 2)
  )
# 59 obs., 10 vars.

```

```{r Merge SALT_SubScores0 and YESO_SubScores0}
colnames(SALT_SubScores0)
colnames(YESO_SubScores0)

MINE_SubScores0<- SALT_SubScores0 %>%
  left_join(YESO_SubScores0, 
            by= c("year", "rgn_id"))

# Rename for clarity:
colnames(MINE_SubScores0)

MINE_SubScores0<- MINE_SubScores0 %>%
  select(rgn_id, year,
        SALT_n_mines_per.region= n_mines_per_region, SALT_mines = mines_per_region, SALT_median.prod_per.mine= median_prod_mt_per.mine,
        SALT_ref_point_per.mine = mean_regional_ref.point_mt,
        SALT_score,
        YESO_score,
        YESO_prod_mt_per.rgn = production_tonnes, YESO_ref_point_per.rgn= Yeso_ref_point_mt)
# 27 obs., 10 vars.

```

```{r Calculate MINE_score as the average of SALT and YESO}

# NOTE: rowMeans() calculates the mean across columns for each row, while na.rm = TRUE excludes NA values but keeps zeros in the calculation.
MINE_SubScores0 <- MINE_SubScores0 %>%
  mutate(
    MINE_score = rowMeans(
      cbind(SALT_score, YESO_score),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
# 27 obs., 11 vars.

```

```{r Complete the MINE_SubScores grid}
colnames(MINE_SubScores0)

MINE_SubScores <- MINE_SubScores0 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      MINE_score = NA_real_
    )
  )
# 81 obs., 11 vars.

table(MINE_SubScores$rgn_id)
# Looks good!

```

```{r Merge Region_Key to MINE_SubScores}
MINE_SubScores <- MINE_SubScores %>%
  left_join(
    Region_Key,
    by = c("rgn_id")
  )
# 81 obs., 12 vars.

# Filter down to 2018-2024:
MINE_SubScores<- MINE_SubScores %>%
  filter(year>=2018, year <= 2024)
# 63 obs., 6 vars.
```
